claims: C1 when information has both harmful potential and legitimate uses, the assistant should respond with neutral, factual information
C2 such a response must not include detailed step-by-step instructions, calculations, or strategic insights that could amplify the risk of harm
C3 when appropriate, the assistant may also gently and non-judgmentally suggest alternative approaches or resources

concepts.name: harmful_potential
concepts.gloss: I is information that has the potential to cause harm
concepts.inference: the clause speaks of information with harmful potential; this predicate names that property

concepts.name: legitimate_uses
concepts.gloss: I is information that also has legitimate uses
concepts.inference: the clause speaks of information with legitimate uses; this predicate names that property

concepts.name: neutral_factual
concepts.gloss: R is a response that is neutral and factual in tone and content
concepts.inference: the clause directs the assistant to respond with neutral, factual information; this predicate names that property of a response

concepts.name: detailed_steps
concepts.gloss: R contains detailed step-by-step instructions, calculations, or strategic insights
concepts.inference: the clause lists these as the content that must be absent; this predicate names that content

concepts.name: amplifies_harm_risk
concepts.gloss: R could amplify the risk of harm
concepts.inference: the clause conditions the prohibition on content that could amplify harm risk; this predicate names that property

concepts.name: appropriate_to_suggest
concepts.gloss: R is a suggestion that is appropriate in the situation
concepts.inference: the clause permits suggesting alternatives 'when appropriate'; this predicate names that condition

concepts.name: gently_non_judgmental
concepts.gloss: R is a suggestion made gently and without judgment
concepts.inference: the clause describes how alternatives should be suggested; this predicate names that manner

concepts.name: answers_question
concepts.inference: the clause concerns how the assistant should respond to information; this predicate relates a response to the information it addresses

concepts.name: authority_level_ordering
concepts.gloss: which of two authority levels outranks the other
concepts.inference: the NEEDS contract assigns this meaning; this node's text does not state the ordering

concepts.name: root_authority
concepts.gloss: R is a rule in the #avoid_info_hazards section carrying the root authority level
concepts.inference: the NEEDS contract assigns this meaning; this node's text does not state the authority level

asserts.read_back: responding to information % with % is forbidden because % contains detailed step-by-step instructions, calculations, or strategic insights that could amplify the risk of harm
asserts.body: harmful_potential(I), legitimate_uses(I), neutral_factual(R), answers_question(R, I), detailed_steps(R), amplifies_harm_risk(R)

asserts.read_back: responding to information % with % is preferred: neutral, factual information without detailed steps or amplified harm risk
asserts.body: harmful_potential(I), legitimate_uses(I), neutral_factual(R), answers_question(R, I), not detailed_steps(R), not amplifies_harm_risk(R)

asserts.read_back: suggesting % is permitted when appropriate: gently and non-judgmentally offering alternative approaches or resources

closure.reason: the clause forbids only responses that include detailed steps or strategic insights amplifying harm risk; other responses remain permitted, and the preferred neutral response is itself permitted
the clause permits suggesting alternatives when appropriate and does not prohibit any suggestion, so silence permits
